mapper.sql: create_time ,update_time,bool_delete_enum,version, id, classification_name, production_line_type_enum, parent_type, min_length, bool_contains_min, max_length, bool_contains_max, definition_word, artifact_type, coding_type, sort
mapper.select:
select sc.*, ss.id ss_id, ss.spec_prefix, ss.production_line_type_enum ss_production_line_type_enum, sn.id sn_id, sn.serial_number_prefix, sn.production_line_type_enum sn_production_line_type_enum from sys_structure_classification as sc inner join sys_structure_spec as ss on sc.id = ss.structure_classification_id and ss.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_structure_serial_number_prefix as sn on sc.id = sn.structure_classification_id and sn.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE sc.bool_delete_enum = 0
and sc.id IN
#{classificationId}
order by sc.production_line_type_enum, sc.sort, sc.artifact_type, sc.id

SELECT sc.production_line_type_enum sc_production_line_type_enum, (case sc.production_line_type_enum WHEN 1 THEN NULL ELSE sc.parent_type END) sc_parent_type, ssc.id, ssc.classification_name, case ssc.production_line_type_enum WHEN 1 then NULL ELSE ssc.parent_type END parent_type, ssc.artifact_type, ssc.production_line_type_enum, ssc.coding_type, ssc.sort, ssc.spec_prefix , ssc.ss_production_line_type_enum, ssc.serial_number_prefix, ssc.sn_production_line_type_enum FROM ( SELECT sc.production_line_type_enum, IFNULL(sc.parent_type, 0) parent_type FROM sys_structure_classification AS sc WHERE sc.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND sc.production_line_type_enum = #{productionLineTypeEnum}
AND sc.classification_name like concat('%',#{classificationName},'%')
GROUP BY sc.production_line_type_enum, sc.parent_type ORDER BY sc.production_line_type_enum, sc.parent_type ) sc LEFT JOIN ( select sc.id, sc.classification_name, IFNULL(sc.parent_type, 0) parent_type, sc.production_line_type_enum, sc.artifact_type, sc.coding_type, sc.max_length, sc.min_length, sc.definition_word, sc.sort, ss.spec_prefix, ss.production_line_type_enum ss_production_line_type_enum, sn.serial_number_prefix, sn.production_line_type_enum sn_production_line_type_enum from sys_structure_classification as sc left join sys_structure_spec as ss on sc.id = ss.structure_classification_id and ss.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_structure_serial_number_prefix as sn on sc.id = sn.structure_classification_id and sn.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE sc.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND sc.production_line_type_enum = #{productionLineTypeEnum}
AND sc.classification_name like concat('%',#{classificationName},'%')
order by sc.production_line_type_enum, sc.parent_type, sc.sort, sc.artifact_type, sc.id ) ssc ON sc.production_line_type_enum = ssc.production_line_type_enum AND sc.parent_type = ssc.parent_type ORDER BY sc.production_line_type_enum, sc.parent_type, ssc.sort, ssc.id
